title: Synthesis of Novel 1,3,5-Triazine Analogues With Selective Activity Against Pancreatic (Capan-1) and Colorectal (HCT-116) Carcinomas: Anticancer Potential and DNA-Binding Affinity.
authors: Asghar, Shazia; Aziz, Aftab; Hameed, Shahid; Saeed, Bahjat A; Allami, Risala H; Al-Masoudi, Najim A
one_liner_zh: 该文合成三嗪类化合物并测其与小牛胸腺DNA结合亲和力及抗癌活性，虽涉及DNA结合但为小分子药物筛选，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且对接对象为PDEdelta蛋白而非TF-DNA体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: A series of 2-(2-arylidenehydrazinyl)-4,6-bis(substituted-phenoxy)-1,3,5-triazines (compounds 3a-o to 7a-o) was synthesized and evaluated for DNA-binding affinity using calf thymus DNA. Based on their DNA interaction profiles, the top three compounds from each series were selected for in vitro anticancer screening against eight human cancer cell lines, encompassing both solid tumors (glioblastoma, pancreatic adenocarcinoma, colorectal carcinoma, and lung carcinoma) and hematological malignancies (acute lymphoblastic leukemia, acute myeloid leukemia, chronic myeloid leukemia, and non-Hodgkin lymphoma). Among the tested compounds, 5i and 7b demonstrated the highest anticancer potency against pancreatic adenocarcinoma (Capan-1), with IC(50) values of 2.4 and 1.9 microM, respectively. Notably, compound 5i also exhibited strong cytotoxicity against colorectal carcinoma (HCT-116), with an IC(50) of 2.2 microM. Additional analogues namely 3i, 3l, 6g, 6l, and 7m displayed IC(50) values ranging from 7.4 to 42.2 microM across the panel of cancer cell lines, highlighting the superior activity of 5i and 7b as promising antiproliferative agents. Molecular docking studies revealed that compound 7b formed strong interactions with the prenyl-binding protein PDEdelta, and subsequent molecular dynamics simulations confirmed the stability of the 7b-PDEdelta complex, supporting its potential as a targeted anticancer agent.
abstract_zh: 合成了一系列2-(2-亚芳基肼基)-4,6-双(取代苯氧基)-1,3,5-三嗪类化合物（化合物3a-o至7a-o），并使用小牛胸腺DNA评估了其DNA结合亲和力。基于其DNA相互作用谱，从每个系列中选出前三种化合物，针对八种人类癌细胞系进行体外抗癌筛选，涵盖实体瘤（胶质母细胞瘤、胰腺腺癌、结直肠癌和肺癌）和血液系统恶性肿瘤（急性淋巴细胞白血病、急性髓系白血病、慢性髓系白血病和非霍奇金淋巴瘤）。在测试的化合物中，5i和7b对胰腺腺癌（Capan-1）表现出最高的抗癌效力，其IC(50)值分别为2.4和1.9微摩尔。值得注意的是，化合物5i还对结直肠癌（HCT-116）表现出强细胞毒性，IC(50)为2.2微摩尔。其他类似物，即3i、3l、6g、6l和7m，在癌细胞系面板中显示出7.4至42.2微摩尔的IC(50)值，突显了5i和7b作为有前景的抗增殖剂的优越活性。分子对接研究揭示，化合物7b与异戊二烯结合蛋白PDEdelta形成强相互作用，随后的分子动力学模拟确认了7b-PDEdelta复合物的稳定性，支持其作为靶向抗癌剂的潜力。
